1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Bc.strategy: Retreats the bishop but keeps it on the diagonal that points at f7 and at the d5 square. The bishop is away from the centre and can be harassed, so White trades a little time for lasting pressure against Black's kingside.
1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Bc.name: Sicilian Defence: Alapin Variation, Stoltz Attack

1.e4 c5 2.c3 Nf6 3.e5 Nd5 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Bc.strategy: Hits the bishop with a pawn and takes space at once. Bxc4 loses the bishop for a pawn to ...Nxc4, so the bishop has to retreat. Black takes the d3 square from White, but the pawn needs the knight's support and no longer controls d4.
